buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

Additional Terms & Conditions 1. Scope of Work: The service provider shall provide goods transportation services as per the requirement, routes, loc ations, quantity and schedule specified by the Consignee/Indenting Authority. 2. Vehicle Availability: Suitable vehicles of the required capacity and type shall be provided by the service provider as and when requisitioned by the Consignee/Authorized Representative. 3. Vehicle Condition: All vehicles deployed shall be in good running condition, clean, roadworthy and suitable for transpor tation of the specified goods. 4. Valid Documents: Vehicles deployed shall possess valid Registration Certificate (RC), Insurance, Pollution Unde r Control (PUC), Fitness Certificate and Permit, wherever applicable. The driver shall possess a valid driving licence for the category of vehicle deployed. 5. Driver: Drivers deployed shall be experienced, properly licensed and conversant with the routes/operational requirements. The contractor shall be responsible for the conduct and discipline of the drivers. 6. Loading & Unloading: Loading and unloading of goods shall be carried out as specified in the scope of work. Any additional manpower/equipment required for the same shall be arranged by the service provider unless specifi cally excluded in the bid. 7. Safe Transportation: The service provider shall be responsible for safe transportation of goods from the point of loading t o the designated destination. Any loss or damage attributable to negligence of the service provider shall be dealt with as per applicable contractual provisions. 8. Timely Deployment: Vehicles shall report at the designated location at the stipulated time. Delay in deployment without valid reasons may attract deductions/penalties as per the terms of the contract. 9. Replacement Vehicle: In case of breakdown or non-availability of a deployed vehicle, the service provider shall arrange a s uitable replacement vehicle at no additional cost to the Consignee. 10. No Subletting: The service provider shall not sublet or transfer the awarded service to any other agency without pr ior written approval of the Competent Authority. 11. Fuel & Maintenance: Cost of fuel, lubricants, routine maintenance, repairs, insurance, taxes and other operational expens es shall be borne by the service provider, unless specifically provided otherwise in the bid. 12. Statutory Compliance: The service provider shall comply with all applicable Central/State Government laws, Motor Vehicle Rules, labour laws, taxation requirements and other statutory provisions during execution of the con tract. 13. Security/Safety Requirements: The service provider and its personnel shall comply with all security and entry regulations applicabl e at the locations where the transportation service is undertaken. 14. Verification of Personnel: The service provider shall provide details of drivers/personnel deployed, including identification and driving licence details, whenever required by the Consignee/Competent Authority. 15. Route & Destination: The Consignee shall specify the route/destination for each transportation requirement. Any deviatio n from the authorized route shall require prior approval, except in an emergency. 16. Proof of Delivery (POD): The service provider shall obtain acknowledgement/signature of the authorized receiving represent ative as proof of delivery wherever required and submit the same along with the invoice. 17. Measurement/Billing: Payment shall be made based on the actual service rendered, duly certified by the authorized re presentative, and in accordance with the rates accepted in the GeM contract. 18. No Extra Charges: No additional charges towards fuel, toll, parking, driver allowance, maintenance or other incidental expenses shall be payable beyond the accepted contract rates, unless specifically permitted under t he bid terms. 19. Toll/Taxes: Toll charges, taxes and other statutory charges shall be dealt with as specifically indicated in the pri ce schedule/bid. No claim outside the accepted terms shall be entertained.

20. Penalty for Non-Performance: Failure to provide the required vehicle/service within the stipulated time, without valid justification, may attract penalty/service-level deductions as specified in the bid/GeM contract. 21. Inspection/Verification: The Consignee/Authorized Representative shall have the right to verify the vehicle, documents and service performance before/during deployment. 22. Confidentiality: The service provider and its personnel shall not disclose any information relating to the consignmen ts, routes, locations or other official matters encountered during execution of the contract. 23. Accident/Third-Party Liability: The service provider shall be responsible for compliance with applicable statutory requirements and liabilities arising from accidents or third-party claims attributable to its vehicle/personnel. 24. Payment: Payment shall be processed through GeM after satisfactory completion of the service and submissio n of the required documents, including invoice and POD/service completion certificate, as applicable . 25. Contract Period: The service shall remain valid for the period specified in the GeM bid/contract. Extension, if required , shall be subject to applicable GeM provisions and approval of the Competent Authority. 26. The service provider shall ensure that the driver(s) and vehicle(s) deployed for the contract comply with all security instructions and entry restrictions imposed by the Defence establishment. No unaut horized person shall accompany the vehicle. The service provider shall ensure that all personnel de ployed are available for verification by the authorized representative/security staff whenever requir ed. 27. The quote rate should include SNT Tax, all bidders to check the same with SNT before bidding. 28. .
